name: dual-usb4-strix-halo-wiki
title: Dual-USB4 Strix Halo Transport Wiki
target: Two Linux AMD Strix Halo / Ryzen AI Max nodes connected by two host-to-host USB4 cables
primary_recommendation: Require two coexisting USB4NET paths, route them as separate point-to-point subnets, and use MPTCP for one llama.cpp RPC stream
custom_runtime_recommendation: Use two source-bound TCP sockets with framed chunk striping; evaluate two USB4STREAM devices only as a Linux 7.2-era experiment
same_peer_gate: If attaching the second cable removes or replaces the first XDomain/netdev, dual-link exposure has failed; prefer separate domainX/NHI instances on both nodes

inventory.definition: Counts exclude SHA256SUMS and external archive files

limitations: No physical Strix Halo dual-USB4 measurements were performed in the artifact build environment
MkDocs strict build was not run because documentation dependencies were absent
Native MPTCP runtime was not available on the build environment's Linux 4.4.0 kernel
